description: MotionVid turns a prompt or a script into a finished motion graphics video. Describe what you need, like an animated logo reveal, a product ad, a how-it-works explainer, an animated infographic or a map explainer, and MotionVid plans the scenes, animates them, adds narration and music, and renders an MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.  Pick a style such as claymation, paper collage or flat vector, apply your brand kit, preview frames before rendering, and ask for changes to an existing video without starting over. Works with your MotionVid account on any paid plan.
